g.title: J8
g.text: Zero 2 W physical pins. Pin 1 also feeds the Clapper and U6; see wiring-io.

g.title: U1
g.text: Adafruit 3006. VIN-SD: left; VIN-GAIN: 6 dB. C1/C2 at VIN;
supply: wiring-power. Neither SPK terminal is ground.

g.text: Adafruit 3351, 4 ohm / 3 W. Decoupled mounting. Factory lead to

g.title: U2
g.text: 3.3 V only. Gasket and membrane seal bottom port to faceplate.

g.text: 200 mm Standard-Mini ribbon; contacts face PCB.

g.text: IMX708 Wide with IR-cut filter; 15-pin ribbon end.
